sloka: न दैत्यदानवेभ्यो वा भयमस्ति हि तादृशम् ।यादृशं मानुषं राजन् भयमस्मानुपस्थितम् ।। ६.६०.७४ ।।।।
transliteration: na daityadānavebhyo vā bhayamasti hi tādṛśam ।yādṛśaṁ mānuṣaṁ rājan bhayamasmānupasthitam ।। 6.60.74 ।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier this great city was burnt by a single Vanara who killed Prince Aksha, and his elephants and followers."
